feature_requests: Onboarding command to walk users through obtaining a Plex token
pain_points: Docker deployments of Plex use different filesystem paths than the host, requiring manual --path-map translation for filesystem comparison and triage commands
Config file must be manually chmod'd to 400 since plexctl only warns (rather than enforces) about group/other-readable permissions
Fansub-style anime filenames break Plex's built-in filename-based episode matching, requiring a separate .plexmatch generation workflow
Long-running anime series have multiple conflicting TMDB season/episode orderings (e.g. One Piece has 4+), requiring manual --ordering selection to get correct numbering
GitHub repo is a push-only mirror, implying issues/PRs may not be accepted or monitored there

feature_requests: Typed mutation commands with explicit confirmation gates (raw API mutations currently intentionally rejected)
Full coverage of metadata children endpoint across all servers/item types (currently 404s on some due to being outside pinned OpenAPI contract)
pain_points: Raw API mutation calls are blocked entirely since no typed command with confirmation exists yet, limiting write workflows to read-only
metadata children targets a route not present in the pinned OpenAPI contract, causing inconsistent 404s depending on server/item type
IP-literal server endpoints require disabling certificate verification since Plex's cert cannot match the IP, a workaround rather than a real fix
Legacy environment-token auth config still needs to be supported alongside the newer OS credential store, adding auth complexity

narrative.headline: Read Plex Media Server resources through a typed CLI with protected credential storage.
narrative.value_prop: Use the CLI to inspect a configured Plex server and automate read-only operational checks. Authentication is stored only after a verified Plex authorization flow.
narrative.auth_narrative: Start the device authorization flow with `plexctl-pp-cli auth login`; the CLI verifies the resulting credential before saving it and never prints the token.

quickstart.comment: Check whether a verified credential is already available.
Authorize in a browser when status reports no credential.

troubleshoots.fix: Run `plexctl-pp-cli auth status` and then complete `plexctl-pp-cli auth login` if needed.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for read-only Plex Media Server inspection, automation, and health workflows. Do not use it to perform unsupported raw mutations.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to expose credentials or access tokens.
